capabilities: Look up word etymologies in English, Spanish, and French from online dictionaries
Trigger lookups by highlighting a word, right-clicking, using the command palette, or a ribbon icon
Copy results, paste them at the cursor, or save them into a dictionary note's frontmatter property
Cache lookup results in memory with a configurable TTL
Set a default language to skip the language prompt
extras: Requires an internet connection; fetches data from online dictionaries (Etymonline, RAE, Diccionario Etimológico de Chile, Wiktionnaire, CNRTL). Manual installation only, no community plugin store install described.
intentEvidence: It is a fork and extension of the Etymology Lookup plugin by clairefro
motivation: The author forked and extended the Etymology Lookup plugin to add multilingual support, dictionary integration, caching, and more.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up a word's etymology while writing, and the original Etymology Lookup plugin only supported English.

relations.evidence: It is a fork and extension of the Etymology Lookup plugin by clairefro

summary: Etymology lookup tool that fetches word origins in English, Spanish, and French from online dictionaries and inserts them into notes.
